message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine statutory charge(s) based on facts: organizing illegal paid blood donation. Chinese criminal law: "非法组织献血罪" (illegal organization of blood donation) under Article 336 of Criminal Law (maybe). Also "非法买卖血液罪"? Actually Chinese law: Article 336: "非法组织献血、买卖血液的，处三年以下有期徒刑、拘役或者管制，并处或者单处罚金". Also "非法收买血液" etc. The fact: recruiting paid blood donors without approval, organizing them to donate for profit. So charge: "非法组织献血罪". Possibly also "非法经营罪"? But likely just one.

Thus answer: [罪名]非法组织献血罪<eoa>
